summary: Freeport-McMoRan Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that PT Freeport Indonesia, its 48.76%-owned subsidiary, amended and restated its $1.75 billion senior unsecured revolving credit facility on September 1, 2026, extending maturity from November 2028 to September 2031. PTFI had $250 million borrowed as of that date; proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium or ownership change was disclosed. This is an ordinary credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch nothing for arbitrage, though extended liquidity modestly eases PTFI funding risk.
